credibility_gap.derived_from: Pillar post, 'Leak #1: The Trust Deficit on High-Ticket Quotes' — a free @gmail.com address vs. a domain you own, at the moment a customer decides whether to trust you with a deposit.
credibility_gap.no_new_claims: Uses no percentage or statistic. The pillar post's own '74%' and '40%' figures are NOT repeated here — they are unsourced and out of step with the no-invented-statistics rule; this ad set argues the mechanism instead, per VOICE.md's 'name the mechanism, not a statistic' signature move.

dm_chaos.derived_from: Pillar post, 'Leak #2: The Infinite DM Back-and-Forth' — answering price/availability/location questions by hand, after hours, versus a page that answers instantly.

rented_land.derived_from: Pillar post, 'Leak #3: You Own Zero Customer Data' — algorithm/account risk on a platform you don't own, versus a domain, email list, and page that are actually yours.

verification.method: Every URL below was curled live (curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}') before being written into this file. 28 unique URLs checked (18 tracked landing URLs, 9 compact link variants embedded in tight-limit copy, plus the distributed blog post), all HTTP 200. Zero /web/-prefixed URLs appear anywhere in this file (grep-verified).
